messages.subject: Western Digital Thailand | Advanced manufacturing, sustainability and country stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Thanchanok Rakkaew,

Western Digital's extensive manufacturing footprint in Thailand and current hiring across Bang Pa-in and Prachin Buri make the company a strong target for my international executive background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

I bring experience managing complex regulator interfaces, community priorities and cross-functional delivery in a multinational environment. My recent work also includes large-scale solar and battery-storage transition support and carbon-data governance. I would add value where manufacturing growth, sustainability and institutional relationships need to move together.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country operations. I have attached a Western Digital Thailand-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
